title: One repository, three audiences
description: What you write, what the tooling checks and generates, and who reads the result.

nodes.title: You write
nodes.detail: content/<mod>/index.md for people, content/<mod>/mod.toml for facts, and the mod's files beside them.

nodes.title: ./buildSite
nodes.detail: Validates, packages byte-reproducible archives, renders offline docs, writes manifests and the site index.

nodes.title: Zola renders
nodes.detail: The mod page, its docs, its changelog and the network page, all from the same generated data.

nodes.title: Players
nodes.detail: Read the page, download the archive, follow the install section.

nodes.title: Clients and indexes
nodes.detail: CHIMERA, St4sh and anything else read dreamweave.json and the manifests. No HTML scraping.

nodes.title: Mirrors
nodes.detail: Serve the same bytes under the same SHA-256. They never become the authority.
